read.thesis: Q3 2024 returned UPS to revenue and profit growth: US ADV +6.5% and cost per piece -4.1%, with FY revenue raised to ~$91.1B and margin to ~9.6%, though peak volume outlook softened.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures are expected to be about $4 billion.

triggers.label: Capacity out: 45 closures, ~1M ADV
triggers.quote: 45 operational closures, it's about 1 million ADV per day of capacity that we've taken out of the market

triggers.label: Automated hub volume 63%, up 5 pts
triggers.quote: we now processed 63% of the volume in our hubs in some sort of an automated way. That's up 5 percentage points from a year ago.

triggers.label: Base rates lift RPP 170 bps
triggers.quote: base rates increased the revenue per piece growth rate by 170 basis points

triggers.label: Mix/weight drag -300 bps on RPP
triggers.quote: the combination of product mix, lighter weights and shorter zones decreased the revenue per piece growth rate by 300 basis points

triggers.label: Peak forecasts tempered, 2% to 11%
triggers.quote: forecasts are all over the board, candidly from a low of 2% to a high of 11%

triggers.label: FY revenue ~$91.1B, margin ~9.6%
triggers.quote: we now expect consolidated revenue of approximately $91.1 billion for the year and are lifting our consolidated operating margin target to approximately 9.6%

guidance.quote: we now expect consolidated revenue of approximately $91.1 billion for the year
lifting our consolidated operating margin target to approximately 9.6%
We expect to generate a fourth quarter operating margin of approximately 9.5%
we expect free cash flow to be around $5.1 billion after the $1.4 billion pension contribution
Capital expenditures are expected to be about $4 billion.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Return to revenue and profit growth in Q3
prior_guidance_check.quote: we said that the second quarter would not only be the bottom, but a turning point for our performance and that we would return to revenue and profit growth in the third quarter, which we did

red_flags.label: Peak volume forecasts tempered
red_flags.quote: recently, shippers have tempered their volume expectations

red_flags.label: Air volume down 6.3%, largest customer glide-down
red_flags.quote: 100% of the decline in air volume was down about 6.5% that is attributable to the largest customer

evasions.quote: we're confident we can work through this
let us get through the fourth quarter and then we'll give you our outlook for 2025
